title: Austin Election Results Finalized
summary:
*   Austin city officials convened a special meeting to formally review and confirm the outcomes of the May 4th run-off election.
*   The primary purpose was to officially "canvass the returns," ensuring the accurate finalization of votes cast.
*   This administrative step was crucial for formalizing the results and recognizing the winners of the recent local election.
transcript:
CITY OF AUSTIN, TEXAS
May 06, 1963
NOTICE OF SPECIAL MEETING
TO THE MEMBERS OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF AUSTIN: Notice is hereby given that a
Special Meeting of the City Council of the City of Austin will be held on the 6th day of
May, 1963, at the Municipal Building, Eighth and Colorado, in Austin, Texas, at 10:00 A.M.
for the purpose of canvassing the returns of the Run-off Election of May 4, 1963. s/ Elsie
Woosley
City Clerk
s/ Lester E. Palmer
Mayor
City of Austin, Texas
ATTEST:
s/ Elsie Woosley
City Clerk
CONSENT TO MEETING
We, the undersigned members of the City Council, hereby accept service of the foregoing
notice, waiving any and all irregularities in such service and such notice, and consent
and agree that said City Council shall meet at the time and place therein named, and for
the purpose therein stated. s/ L. F. Shanks
s/ Ben White
s/ R. C. Armstrong
s/ Edgar Perry
